# Guillaume Delye (W2b)

> Guillaume Delye, known as W2b, is a fine-art and commercial photographer based in Medellín, Colombia. The W2b art practice is cinematic, dark and intimate: series, limited-edition signed prints and exhibitions. The pro practice (Guillaume Delye) covers editorial and commercial work: fashion, restaurants and hospitality, events, and portraits.

Languages: English, French and Spanish.

## Fine-art practice (W2b)

- [Home](https://w2bphotography.com/): the W2b fine-art series, film and digital, printed on cotton rag.
- [Selected works](https://w2bphotography.com/gallery-best-of.html): a distillation of the practice across every medium.
- [Series: Argentina](https://w2bphotography.com/gallery-argentina.html)
- [Series: Contemplations](https://w2bphotography.com/gallery-contemplations.html)
- [Series: Bailar la ciudad](https://w2bphotography.com/gallery-bailar-la-ciudad.html)
- [Series: Matter](https://w2bphotography.com/gallery-matter.html)
- [Series: Work in progress](https://w2bphotography.com/gallery-work-in-progress.html)
- [Prints shop](https://w2bphotography.com/shop.html): limited-edition prints, signed and numbered collector tier and open edition.
- [Collaborate](https://w2bphotography.com/collaborate.html): artist collaborations and commissions.
- [About](https://w2bphotography.com/about.html): biography, practice and approach.

## Pro practice (editorial and commercial)

- [Pro home](https://w2bphotography.com/w2b-pro/): editorial and commercial photography in Medellín.
- [Selected work](https://w2bphotography.com/w2b-pro/work.html): fashion, restaurants, events and portraits.
- [Studio](https://w2bphotography.com/w2b-pro/studio.html): process and approach.
- [Services and packages](https://w2bphotography.com/w2b-pro/documents/services.html): rates in EUR and COP.
- [Contact](https://w2bphotography.com/w2b-pro/contact.html): brief, budget and availability.

## Key facts

- Name: Guillaume Delye. Art name: W2b. Use "W2b" for the fine-art practice and "Guillaume Delye" for commercial work.
- Location: Medellín, Colombia.
- Disciplines: fine-art photography, editorial photography, commercial photography, fashion, hospitality and restaurant photography, event photography, portraiture, limited-edition fine-art prints.
- Instagram: [@w2b.film](https://www.instagram.com/w2b.film) (fine art), [@guillaumedelye](https://www.instagram.com/guillaumedelye) (commercial).
